about_the_game:
Faroda is a challenging 2D platformer with colorful pixel-art graphics and chiptune soundtrack.

In this demo you'll be able to play the first 20 levels, collecting treasure chests and many hidden gems along the way.

Will you be able to help Faroda, the protagonist of this adventure, gather the immense wealth scattered throughout the first island of the archipelago?

FEATURES

  • Play the first 20 levels of the first island.

  • A challenging and never frustrating experience, thanks to instant respawns and frequent checkpoints.

  • Full keyboard and gamepad support (gamepad is recommended).

  • A tutorial that teaches you all the gameplay mechanics to get started.

  • A lot of collectible gems to find.

  • Many hidden passages to discover.

  • Colorful pixel art graphics.

  • A chiptune soundtrack.
